title: ui_net
summary: MSUI now matches current Benilla's desktop connection telemetry: the first and subsequent CMSG_PING sends use the verified delayed 30-second cadence (never the vmangos-overspeed 10-second loop), the wire's lastRtt field reports the latest matched SMSG_PONG sample, and the UI-facing LatencyMs is the truncated mean of a reset-per-connection 16-sample ring. The protected performance-meter art, thresholds and tooltip presentation are unchanged. Focused and full interface checks pass; live long-session verification remains.

openItems.text: MSUI sent pings every 10 seconds and fed an exponential latency estimate to both the next ping and the UI; current Benilla uses a 30-second keepalive, latest RTT on wire, and a 16-sample mean for GetNetStats.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: moved the timer to delayed 30-second cadence, separated latest RTT from the UI average, and added the bounded 16-sample ring with focused source/constant checks.

openItems.text: Live verification: keep a desktop session connected for several minutes, confirm one ping per 30 seconds, no overspeed disconnect, latest-RTT echo on wire, and stable averaged performance-meter color/text.
